title: Coding with OpenAI o1
summary: Scott Wu, CEO and Co-Founder of Cognition, explains how OpenAI o1 makes coding decisions in a more human-like way.
body: Scott Wu, CEO and Co-Founder of Cognition, explains how OpenAI o1 makes coding decisions in a more human-like way.
summaryZh: Cognition联合创始人兼CEO斯科特·吴（Scott Wu）详细说明了OpenAI o1模型如何以更具人类风格的方式做出编程决策，展现了其在软件工程和复杂代码生成任务上的突破。原始信息显示：Scott Wu, CEO and Co-Founder of Cognition, explains how OpenAI o1 makes coding decisions in a more human-like way.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Coding with OpenAI o1”。其重要性主要体现在：认知公司CEO探讨了OpenAI o1在人类风格代码编写决策上的表现。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
